items.title: Leaders Too Scared to Ask What AI Is
items.summary: In episode 1035 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Carly Taylor, Founder of Rebel Data Science, why so many leaders feel overwhelmed by AI and are too afraid to ask what it is. Carly calls that fear the place where innovation goes to die, and explains that fearing the fear itself leaves you no less afraid, just not at a place where you can walk off the stage and say "wow, I did it."

items.title: JEV Mapped to 4B Qwen3 in Agent Harness: NEW CODE
items.summary: Now the first question you have is: WHY map a decision JEV system back to a classical LLM? We invented simple decisions systems like JEV to break away from the complexity and costs of LLM. The solution is presented in my new video. All rights w/ authors: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs Kunlun Zhu1, Tao Feng1, Xu Han1, Heng Wang1, Ling Yang2, Xiangru Tang3, Jiaxuan You1, Heng Ji1 from 1 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 2 Princeton University 3 Google #airesearch #aiexplained #aiinnovation #qwen
